The horizontal axis marks 110°E and 115°E, and the right side is close to the Bohai Sea. In the figure, location Yi is located in the area from near 110°E to west of 115°E, with a relatively large profile height and obvious surface undulations; near 115°E, the terrain drops obviously, and location Jia on the east side is relatively low and flat. Reasoning: Location Yi has relatively high terrain and large undulations, so agricultural use should suit local conditions. Slopes and mountains are suitable for developing forestry and animal husbandry, and local areas with better conditions can develop crop cultivation; it cannot develop only a single crop-farming industry. Therefore, the reasonable direction for agricultural development at location Yi is comprehensive development of agriculture, forestry, and animal husbandry.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：沿38°N剖面中乙地在110°E附近到115°E以西，地势高且起伏明显。再推理：这种地形条件下，耕地、林地、草地应按地形差异配置，不能只发展单一种植业。因此乙地农业发展的合理方向是农、林、牧业综合发展。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：该图是我国沿北纬38°的地形剖面示意图，横轴标出110°E、115°E，右侧接近渤海。图中乙地位于110°E附近到115°E以西一带，剖面高度较大，地表起伏明显；到115°E附近地势明显下降，东侧甲地较低平。推理：乙地地势较高且起伏较大，农业利用应因地制宜，坡地和山地适宜发展林业、牧业，条件较好的局部地区可发展种植业，不能只发展单一种植业。因此，乙地农业发展的合理方向是农、林、牧业综合发展。
